title: Writing the Next Input Payload
statement: Let $M$ be a finite deterministic machine over Booleans, let $x$ be a Boolean word, let $j\in\mathbb{N}$, and let a tape assignment give the contents of the $|M|+1$ data lanes at each integer coordinate. Suppose the current payload at each lane and coordinate is the copied payload of count $j$. After writing the virtual input payload of $x$ at coordinate $j$ on the input lane, the current payload at every lane and coordinate is the copied payload of count $j+1$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite deterministic machine over Booleans
A tape assignment is given for all data lanes and integer coordinates
Every current payload equals the copied payload of count $j$
replaced:
If the current payloads of the data tapes are the copied payloads of count $j$,
then after the copy write placing the virtual input payload of $x$ at position
$j$ at coordinate $j$, the current payloads are the copied payloads of count
$j + 1$.
